# Provenance: coupled-gauge null-space classification, SciPy oracle

`cases.csv` is the output of `gen_reference.py` in this directory, run once on 2026-10-01 after the
pre-registration commit `d429993c`. It holds 72 constructed 9 x 9 Fisher information matrices
(18 null subspaces, four variants each) and, for each, the null-space classification computed by
subspace intersection with singular value decompositions.

- **Tool:** NumPy 2.3.5 and SciPy 1.18.1 (`numpy.linalg.svd`, `scipy.linalg.null_space`,
  `scipy.linalg.orth`, `scipy.linalg.qr`; LAPACK `gesdd`), BSD-3-Clause, in the oracle virtual
  environment `$ORACLE_PY` of `~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh`. Run as a separate program; nothing
  from it is linked into kshana.
- **Inputs:** generated by the script itself from `numpy.random.default_rng(20261001)`; no external
  data. The matrices are written with 17 significant digits and the oracle classifies the parsed
  (committed) values, so Kshana and the oracle see identical inputs.
- **Licence of this fixture:** generated by this project (AGPL-3.0-only, as the repository).
- **SHA-256:** `cases.csv` `da42e710321ab5eb3bbf5f989533fb136bb8b95623725d839f7e51c3d9075bcc`;
  `gen_reference.py` `a102a9e8492da6b32f4c00da6c8de6561d18faa96e2562bceaf97ff85d58ca74`.
- **Reproduce:** `source ~/Code/kshana-oracles/env.sh; $ORACLE_PY gen_reference.py > cases.csv`
  (byte-identical with the same NumPy/SciPy versions).
- **Consumed by:** `tests/lunar_gauge_classification_scipy_oracle.rs`.
